description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Birthing Hulk, adding {C}{C}.
When Birthing Hulk dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Birthing Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Birthing Hulk enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
